core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mikhail is a Russian-origin name meaning “Who is like God?”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Russian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mikhail corresponds to the Russian form ميخائيل (Russian Михаил, from Greek Μιχαήλ). Its core sense is michael; an archangel's name. Mikhail is the Russian form (Михаил) of the Greek Μιχαήλ, the archangel Michael. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled the origin Arabic; the name is Russian/Greek in form. The source gloss 'Who is like God?' is the traditional Hebrew etymology and is broadly consistent.
